name: Western Fuels Association

summary.text: The Western Fuels Association is a not-for-profit cooperative founded in 1973 that supplies coal and transport services to consumer-owned utilities. Under long-time CEO and general counsel Fred Palmer it co-created the 1991 Information Council for the Environment ad campaign and in 1997 set up the Greening Earth Society, an advocacy group on climate change and fossil-fuel use that DeSmog describes as controlled by the association.

facts.claim: DeSmog describes the Western Fuels Association as a not-for-profit cooperative founded in 1973 that supplies coal and transportation services to consumer-owned utilities.
facts.quote: a not-for-profit cooperative that supplies coal and transportation services to consumer-owned utilities, founded in 1973

facts.claim: Fred Palmer spent about 15 years as the association's CEO and general counsel and represented it on the board of the National Mining Association before moving to Peabody Energy.
facts.quote: He spent about 15 years as WFA's CEO and general counsel, and represented WFA on the board of directors of the National Mining Association.

facts.claim: The Western Fuels Association was one of the three creators of the 1991 Information Council for the Environment campaign.
facts.quote: created by the National Coal Association, the Western Fuels Association, and Edison Electrical Institute

facts.claim: The Greening Earth Society was set up in 1997 as a vehicle for advocacy on climate change and fossil-fuel use; DeSmog describes it as controlled by the Western Fuels Association, and a 1998 CLEAR report said the two were essentially the same organisation under Palmer.
facts.quote: The CLEAR report says the two organizations are essentially the same organization, and both shared Palmer as their leader.

connections.claim: The Western Fuels Association co-created ICE in 1991 with the National Coal Association and Edison Electric Institute.
connections.quote: created by the National Coal Association, the Western Fuels Association, and Edison Electrical Institute

connections.claim: The Western Fuels Association and the Edison Electric Institute were co-founders of the 1991 ICE campaign.
connections.quote: created by the National Coal Association, the Western Fuels Association, and Edison Electrical Institute

connections.claim: Western Fuels' long-time CEO Fred Palmer later moved to Peabody Energy.
connections.quote: He later moved to Peabody Energy.

openQuestions: The 'Greening of Planet Earth' video often attributed to Western Fuels was not sourced in this file.
Primary WFA documents (e.g. annual reports) were not opened; DeSmog is an advocacy publisher.
